parameters.responseBody: ={{ { error: "session and message are required (non-empty strings)" } }}

parameters.query:
select
  (select body from kb where id = 1) as kb,
  (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('role', role, 'content', content) order by id), '[]')
     from (select id, role, content from chat_messages where session = $1 order by id desc limit 12) h) as history,
  (select row_to_json(l) from (select name, service, patient_type, preferred_day, status from chat_leads where session = $1) l) as lead,
  (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object(
       'iso', to_char(starts_at at time zone 'Asia/Manila', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"+08:00"'),
       'label', to_char(starts_at at time zone 'Asia/Manila', 'Dy DD Mon HH12AM')) order by starts_at), '[]')
     from slots where booked_by is null and starts_at > now() and starts_at < now() + interval '8 days') as slots

with b as (
  update slots set booked_by = $1
  where $8 = 'book' and starts_at = nullif($9, '')::timestamptz and booked_by is null
  returning starts_at
), r as (
  select case when $8 = 'book' and not exists (select 1 from b) then
    'Sorry, that time was just taken. Other open times: ' || coalesce((
      select string_agg(to_char(starts_at at time zone 'Asia/Manila', 'Dy DD Mon HH12:MI AM'), ', ' order by starts_at)
      from (select starts_at from slots where booked_by is null and starts_at > now()
              and starts_at >= date_trunc('day', nullif($9, '')::timestamptz at time zone 'Asia/Manila') at time zone 'Asia/Manila'
              and starts_at <> nullif($9, '')::timestamptz order by starts_at limit 3) a), 'none this week, a team member will help') || '. Which works for you?'
  else $3 end as reply
), m as (
  insert into chat_messages (session, role, content)
  select $1, 'user', $2 union all select $1, 'assistant', reply from r returning 1
), l as (
  insert into chat_leads (session, name, service, patient_type, preferred_day, status)
  values ($1, nullif($4, ''), nullif($5, ''), nullif($6, ''), nullif($7, ''),
          case when exists (select 1 from b) then 'booked' when $8 = 'handoff' then 'handoff' else 'open' end)
  on conflict (session) do update set
    name = coalesce(excluded.name, chat_leads.name),
    service = coalesce(excluded.service, chat_leads.service),
    patient_type = coalesce(excluded.patient_type, chat_leads.patient_type),
    preferred_day = coalesce(excluded.preferred_day, chat_leads.preferred_day),
    status = case when exists (select 1 from b) then 'booked' when $8 = 'handoff' then 'handoff' else chat_leads.status end,
    updated_at = now()
  returning status
)
select (select reply from r) as reply,
       (select status from l) as status,
       (select count(*) from m) as saved,
       (select to_char(starts_at at time zone 'Asia/Manila', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"+08:00"') from b) as booked_at

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [String($('Chat').item.json.body.session || '').slice(0, 100), String($('Chat').item.json.body.message || '').slice(0, 2000), $('Parse reply').item.json.reply, $('Parse reply').item.json.fields.name || '', $('Parse reply').item.json.fields.service || '', $('Parse reply').item.json.fields.patient_type || '', $('Parse reply').item.json.fields.preferred_day || '', $('Parse reply').item.json.action, $('Parse reply').item.json.booking ? $('Parse reply').item.json.booking.starts_at : ''] }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { reply: $json.reply, fields: $('Parse reply').item.json.fields, action: $json.booked_at ? 'book' : ($('Parse reply').item.json.action === 'book' ? 'none' : $('Parse reply').item.json.action), booking: $json.booked_at ? { starts_at: $json.booked_at } : null } }}
